identity.short_description: Rolpa Multiple Campus is a prominent community-owned higher education institution located in Liwang, Rolpa district, affiliated with Tribhuvan University.
identity.description: Rolpa Multiple Campus was established in 2049 BS (1992 AD) as a community-based campus in the Rolpa district of Lumbini Province, Nepal. It is affiliated with Tribhuvan University and offers various undergraduate and certificate level programs in humanities, management, and education streams to cater to the higher educational needs of students in the remote hilly region.
